summary: United Therapeutics filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026 disclosing an accelerated share repurchase agreement with Citibank, N.A. for approximately $477.6 million of common stock under its existing repurchase program. The company will pay about $477.6 million upfront on or around September 10, 2026 and receive an initial delivery of roughly 719,376 shares, about 75% of the total expected repurchase, based on the September 8 closing price. Final settlement, expected in Q4 2026, is based on daily volume-weighted average prices less a discount, with possible additional shares or cash adjustments. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch settlement share count and residual buyback capacity.
